verdict.rationale: The axis applies: Conductor is a team product with organizations and cloud workspaces, so enterprise SSO or cloud-platform authentication is a fair question. However, the evidence shows only GitHub OAuth or GitHub App sign-in, local GitHub CLI auth, and per-org choice of API key or subscription for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. None of these is enterprise identity (SSO/SAML/OIDC) or cloud-platform authentication (e.g., Bedrock or Vertex), so they are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can authenticate through an enterprise identity or cloud platform for compliance and scalability
